title: Bad Bitches in Class
description: A surreal demonic classroom scene featuring three blue and purple female monsters with horns. In the foreground, a melting blue creature with yellow boils and dripping flesh leans on a desk covered in red and yellow slime. Behind her, two other demonic women stand near a vintage TV displaying the text 'BAD BITCHES IN CLASS'. The background shows a dark, dystopian cityscape with glowing eyes and occult symbols.
